items.why: Caught in the chip selloff described as a broad wipeout, as doubts grow about returns on AI investments.
Crude is climbing as hot producer-inflation data rattles markets and stirs rate-hike worries.
Falling with the chip complex and the tech-heavy Nasdaq as AI-spending worries spread.
The 10-year yield is dropping as investors seek shelter in Treasuries during the AI-trade turbulence.

market_note: S&P futures near flat, Nasdaq futures down; bond yields falling.
summary: The tape is split: the Dow and S&P 500 are holding up while tech and chips sag on fresh doubts about AI spending, with hot inflation data adding pressure.
